findings.rationale: Accepted: §2.1 offered a to_entries/group_by/min_by/sort_by alternative that R4 forbids outright; the alternative is removed, the reduce keep-first form is the only reference shape.
Accepted (same defect as 3b1ed2c0): the sorting-primitive alternative is deleted from §2.1; R4 stands as written.
Accepted: §2.4 now states that a reseal with a freed number re-freezes plan AND rubric together (R9 is re-pinned to the same number), so the row, the reference entry and R9 can never diverge.
